title: G — State transitions / renderer 0.5.5
description: Ten-minute eligibility demonstration: awake 0–1 min, drowsy 1–2, asleep 2–4, awake 4–5, sedated 5–7, comatose 7–9, awake 9–10. Ciganek rhythm is limited to authored awake periods; 14 & 6 Hz bursts to light sleep. Clinical-state labels demonstrate gating, not a typical anesthetic or coma waveform.

title: H — Awake regional muscle / renderer 0.5.5
description: Three-minute awake recording with independent, irregular left/right frontal, temporal and weaker posterior muscle sources. Central muscle is much weaker. Engineering source weights are not measured clinical norms.

title: I — Burst suppression / renderer 0.5.5
description: Three-minute comatose burst-suppression example with reactivity present and no authored motor artifact. Automatic tonic muscle is absent throughout bursts and interbursts; cerebral fast activity is retained.

title: A — Earlier awake model (0.5.4)
description: Earlier 0.5.4 adult background: same seed, 180 s. Existing two-level muscle gate and spatial field.

title: B — Earlier graded trial / same field
description: Offline alternative: continuous positive, irregular multiscale envelope replaces only the earlier two-level gate, preserving the same carrier and remaining channel/time gains. Mean T3 component RMS matched to A.

title: C — Earlier regional trial
description: Offline alternative: independently varying left/right temporalis, frontal and posterior/nuchal proxy sources; 25% within-source shared variance. Candidate weights are authored, not measured clinical coefficients. T3 RMS matched to A.

title: D — Earlier BS control / reactivity present
description: Diagnostic control: authored BS pattern with reactivity changed to present, reproducing the guided-builder muscle eligibility. No seizure or explicit artifact. Tonic EMG grows with burst envelope.

title: E — Earlier BS trial / tonic removed
description: Exact paired offline subtraction of the generated tonic component from D, after 0.5.4 calibration. All cerebral burst content retained. A candidate for the currently intended non-myoclonic teaching examples, not a universal clinical BS rule.

title: F — Earlier unreactive BS control (0.5.4)
description: Earlier 0.5.4 catalog configuration with absent reactivity already emits zero tonic EMG. Remaining fast activity is not evidence of muscle by itself. Separate calibration means F is not a pixel-matched counterpart to D/E.
